thread:
felix: Heads-up — Vendor CloudBridge reports an unexpected spike on their reseller billing for week of 2026-08-10. They claim auto-scaling metered charges applied to partner account instead of customer-hosted pools. Total disputed $6,750 across three invoices. Can finance triage? cc @tara
tara: Oof. Can you attach the invoices and partner mapping?
billing-bot: Files uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/invoices/CB-INV-512 (pdf), https://redwood.cloud/invoices/CB-INV-513 (pdf), https://redwood.cloud/invoices/CB-INV-514 (pdf). Partner mapping: https://redwood.cloud/partners/cloudbridge/mapping.csv
felix: Attached mapping shows partner_flag true but experiment flag 'use_new_scaler' propagated incorrectly during rollout so usage was billed at autoscale metered rates for partner master account instead of being attributed to end customers.
yvonne: Policy check — reseller billing errors OK to issue retro credits to affected end customers or apply partner-level rebate. Partner prefers customer-level credits. Approver: finance manager.
alan: I'm finance manager — pre-approve retro credits if audit confirms misattribution. Use GL 4065 (partner scaling rebates) and create memo referencing pricing experiment rollout PR-1124.
tara: Running audit now. Preliminary totals: INV-CB-512 $2,300, INV-CB-513 $2,250, INV-CB-514 $2,200 = $6,750. I'll create three credit memos and tag FIN-8342.
felix: Customer asks for credits to show on customer invoices rather than partner refund. They also requested a short RCA and assurance this won't recur.
tara: Billing CLI commands:
```
billing-cli apply-credit --invoice INV-CB-512 --amount 2300 --type partner_retail_credit --gl 4065 --note "misattributed autoscale charges - pricing experiment rollout PR-1124"
billing-cli apply-credit --invoice INV-CB-513 --amount 2250 --type partner_retail_credit --gl 4065 --note "misattributed autoscale charges - pricing experiment rollout PR-1124"
billing-cli apply-credit --invoice INV-CB-514 --amount 2200 --type partner_retail_credit --gl 4065 --note "misattributed autoscale charges - pricing experiment rollout PR-1124"
```
billing-bot: Credits created: PC-2026-980, PC-2026-981, PC-2026-982. Status: applied to customer accounts. Linked to ticket FIN-8342 and partner CloudBridge.
yvonne: Please add a GL memo and tag product & infra — this is a rollout flag propagation bug. Also recommend issuing a one-time goodwill promo of $250 to the partner account for operational disruption. Approver: finance director.
alan: Approve $250 goodwill promo. Use GL 4005.
tara: Applying promo to partner account:
```
billing-cli apply-credit --customer CLOUDBRIDGE --amount 250 --type goodwill_promo --gl 4005 --note "goodwill for misattributed autoscale billing during rollout PR-1124"
```
billing-bot: Promo created: GP-2026-034 (applied to partner account). Linked to FIN-8342.
felix: Thanks team. I'll send CloudBridge the credit IDs and GP ID, and attach the audit summary and expected timing (credits visible within 24 hours).
yvonne: Filing RCA and adding post-rollout verification to pricing experiments runbook. Closing loop on billing side. :white_check_mark:
